claims.title: Multiclass argmax decision-preservation proposition
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 각 경쟁 클래스 j에 대해 평문 logit 차이 z_c*-z_j가 두 logit 오차 상한 B_c*+B_j보다 엄격히 크면 CKKS argmax는 평문 argmax c*를 보존한다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: For every competing class j, if the plaintext logit difference z_c*-z_j is strictly greater than the sum of the two logit error bounds B_c*+B_j, the CKKS argmax preserves the plaintext argmax c*.
claims.scope: finite logits with finite class-wise error bounds, strict inequalities, and no plaintext tie
claims.security_qualification: This mathematical proposition is independent of the cryptographic security estimate.
claims.limitation: It is a sufficient finite-observation decision condition, not an instantiated analytical CKKS error certificate or a distribution-wide guarantee.

claims.title: MNIST MLP-100 finite-scope validation and locked audit
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: MNIST 784-100-square-10 MLP에서 동결된 S29 direct literal은 서로 겹치지 않는 500개 configuration-validation 영상과 500개 locked-audit 영상에서 세 fresh key 반복 동안 SAFE였고 argmax flip은 0건이었다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: For the MNIST 784-100-square-10 MLP, the frozen S29 direct literal was SAFE with zero argmax flips across three fresh-key repeats on disjoint 500-image configuration-validation and 500-image locked-audit sets.
claims.scope: one frozen MNIST MLP-100 model, 1,000 predeclared encrypted test images, scalar-replicated execution
claims.security_qualification: The literal passes Security Policy V2 and both declared classical estimator adapters; exact equivalence to Lattigo's truncated error distribution and quantum security are not claimed.
claims.limitation: The result is finite-scope evidence for one trained model, not a guarantee for arbitrary MNIST models or unseen distributions.

claims.title: MNIST LeNet-5-small finite-scope validation and locked audit
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FHE-compatible square-activation LeNet-5-small에서 동결된 S44 direct literal은 서로 겹치지 않는 500개 configuration-validation 영상과 500개 locked-audit 영상에서 세 fresh key 반복 동안 SAFE였고 argmax flip은 0건이었다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: For the FHE-compatible square-activation LeNet-5-small, the frozen S44 direct literal was SAFE with zero argmax flips across three fresh-key repeats on disjoint 500-image configuration-validation and 500-image locked-audit sets.
claims.scope: one frozen MNIST LeNet-5-small model, 1,000 predeclared encrypted test images, declared scalar-replicated adapter
claims.security_qualification: The literal passes Security Policy V2 and both declared classical estimator adapters; exact runtime-distribution equivalence and quantum security are not claimed.
claims.limitation: This adapter is not a claim of arbitrary packed CNN or full general LeNet support.

claims.title: Natural top-two-gap literal activation for MLP-100
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 동결된 MLP-100 validation 범위에서 natural top-two-gap contract는 graph-only fixed-tolerance 기준의 S32와 다른 Security-V2-admitted S29 literal을 합성했으며, 이는 natural decision gap에 의한 literal effect이다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Within the frozen MLP-100 validation scope, the natural top-two-gap contract synthesized a Security-V2-admitted S29 literal distinct from the graph-only fixed-tolerance S32 literal, establishing a natural decision-gap literal effect.
claims.scope: one MNIST MLP-100 graph and its frozen configuration-validation gap contract
claims.security_qualification: Both literals pass Security Policy V2 and the declared classical estimator adapters.
claims.limitation: The paired total-latency ratio for graph-only over gap-aware was 0.999780 with a 95% interval [0.998648, 1.000920]; no gap-aware latency superiority is admitted.
prohibited_wording: natural gaps always change the literal

claims.title: Frozen bounded-catalog coverage on the standard models
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: Frozen Security-V2 catalog의 MLP-100 profile 7개 중 6개는 실행 가능한 SAFE 후보였고 1개는 PLAN_UNSUPPORTED였으며, LeNet-5-small에서는 7개 profile 모두 required depth를 지원하지 못했지만 FlipGuard direct synthesis는 선언된 security gate를 통과하는 literal을 생성하였다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Six of seven frozen Security-V2 catalog profiles were executable SAFE candidates for MLP-100 and one was PLAN_UNSUPPORTED; for LeNet-5-small, all seven profiles lacked the required depth, whereas FlipGuard direct synthesis generated a literal that passed the declared security gate.
claims.scope: the seven frozen Security-V2-admitted catalog profiles only
claims.security_qualification: Catalog coverage is evaluated only after Security-V2 filtering.
claims.limitation: The LeNet outcome is PLAN_UNSUPPORTED_WITHIN_FROZEN_CATALOG, not evidence that no CKKS catalog can contain a SAFE candidate.

claims.title: Focused MLP-100 paired latency
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 동결된 100-image latency subset에서 catalog S40 total latency를 gap-aware S29 total latency로 나눈 image-cluster geometric-mean ratio는 1.981795였고 95% class-stratified bootstrap 구간은 [1.979758, 1.983842]였다. 반면 graph-only S32/S29 ratio는 0.999780, 95% 구간 [0.998648, 1.000920]로 latency superiority를 보이지 않았다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: On the frozen 100-image latency subset, the image-cluster geometric-mean ratio of catalog S40 total latency to gap-aware S29 total latency was 1.981795 with a 95% class-stratified bootstrap interval of [1.979758, 1.983842]. The graph-only S32/S29 ratio was 0.999780 with a 95% interval of [0.998648, 1.000920], providing no latency-superiority evidence.
claims.scope: one host, 100 frozen locked-audit images, three fresh keysets, six measured passes, and three frozen arms
claims.security_qualification: All three paired arms pass Security Policy V2 and the declared classical estimator adapters.
claims.limitation: The graph-only S32 comparator has no separate full 500-image locked audit; its decision checks are limited to the frozen 100-image latency subset. LeNet paired latency was not evaluated.
prohibited_wording: LeNet direct is faster than catalog

claims.title: Qualified security admission for the multiclass literals
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: MLP-100과 LeNet-5-small direct literal 및 MLP paired arm은 exact Q/P materialization에 대해 Security Policy V2와 두 개의 선언된 classical estimator adapter를 통과했으며, Lattigo Xe truncation의 exact estimator equivalence와 quantum 128-bit security는 주장하지 않는다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: The MLP-100 and LeNet-5-small direct literals and the MLP paired arms passed Security Policy V2 and two declared classical estimator adapters over exact Q/P materializations; exact estimator equivalence for Lattigo's truncated Xe distribution and quantum 128-bit security are not claimed.
claims.scope: four materialized multiclass literals and the two declared classical estimator adapters
claims.security_qualification: SECURITY_CORRECTED_AND_REPLAYED; CLASS_S1 result-scope and aggregation mismatch; no policy or literal amendment.
claims.limitation: The estimator uses an untruncated Gaussian proxy for runtime Xe and does not evaluate a quantum cost model.

claims.title: Arbitrary packed-CNN support
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FlipGuard는 본 연구에서 arbitrary packed-CNN support를 입증하지 않았다.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: FlipGuard does not establish arbitrary packed-CNN support in this study.
claims.security_qualification: No security claim is made outside the declared scalar-replicated adapters.
claims.limitation: A general packing compiler and broad CNN architecture study are outside the frozen extension.

paper_claim_allowed_definition: Only exact wording or scoped paraphrases of claims with paper_admitted=true may appear as journal claims.
